Recorded claim:
The 2024 implementation creates and commits headers for Create changes. Update fetches a message but only leaves a comment for future work; Delete and ReadFlagChange still use todo!() in this landed revision. D209933 reviewer required an explicit comment for the no-op Update path; the author avoided todo!() there because it would panic and interrupt sync. The review did not establish full update/delete/read-state support. New EWS code has since been reorganized; study current paths before treating these 2024 limits as current behavior.
